description: Echoes a measurement the previous step produced, as the report block the next step reads.

measurement.description: the value this step is asked to record, already computed upstream

preconditions: the value to record is already in this node's input: this step computes nothing

checks.description: The command prints one fenced result block, and it parses as JSON.

instructions:
# Echo one measurement

This skill runs on the `shell` engine: there is no session and no model. What
executes is `command.argv`, and this body is here so that whoever reads the
registry can tell what the command does without running it.

The command prints one fenced `resultado` block carrying the measurement it was
given, which is the same report protocol every other node uses. It reads nothing
from the filesystem, talks to no network, and inherits no environment variable
of the runner: `env_allowlist` is empty, so `argv[0]` names an absolute path.
